headline: ExchangeRight Fully Subscribes $15.38 Million Essential Income 8 DST as Investors Seek Defined Path to the Essential Income REIT
summary: PASADENA, Calif., July 28, 2026--ExchangeRight has fully subscribed its Essential Income 8 DST, part of its Essential Income DST series.
